met_analysis:
The trough from Gangetic West Bengal to Marathwada now runs from Gangetic West Bengal to Madhya Maharashtra across Jharkhand, interior Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Vidarbha and Marathwada at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from northwest Uttar Pradesh to east Bangladesh across Bihar, Jharkhand and Gangetic West Bengal at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Bihar & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The trough from northeast Bihar to Northeast Bay of Bengal now runs from northcentral Bihar to north Odisha across Jharkhand and Gangetic West Bengal at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
A fresh Western Disturbance seen as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 64°E to the north of Lat. 32°N.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over North Interior Karnataka & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from Comorian Area to cyclonic circulation over North Interior Karnataka across Tamilnadu and South Interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Sikkim & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
